attr.title: Blossom Tales
attr.desc: A top-down action-adventure told as a bedtime story. Grandpa spins Lily a tale about a young knight who must break the sleeping curse the sorcerer Crocus has cast on the king. Explore an open kingdom, clear dungeons, solve puzzles and gather a toybox of classic items, while the narration keeps cheerfully interrupting itself. Hand-drawn pixel art and a design that wears its 16-bit influences proudly.
attr.inst: Buy and install Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King on Steam. Copy only BlossomTales.exe into the blossomtales/gamedata folder. Run Blossom Tales. The first launch unpacks the game and patches it, taking a few minutes.
attr.inst_md:
- Download the `blossomtales.zip` installation package.
- Install it with PortMaster autoinstaller.
- Buy and install Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/446810/Blossom_Tales_The_Sleeping_King/)
- Copy **only** `BlossomTales.exe` into the `blossomtales/gamedata` folder.
- Run Blossom Tales. The first launch unpacks the game and patches it, taking a few minutes.
